fields.default: We asked customers to leave a note after their first month. These went straight onto our office wall.

default.quote: Our designers finally watch the interviews. The clips are short enough that people click them.
default.name: Marcus Lee

default.quote: Tagging used to take me a full day per study. Now I review what Fieldnote found in an hour.
default.name: Sofia Alvarez

default.quote: Sales stopped asking why we built it. I send three clips and the debate is over.
default.name: Tom Okafor

default.quote: The highlight reel replaced our forty-slide research readout. Nobody misses the slides.
default.name: Maya Chen

default.quote: Support tickets and interviews in one place means we finally see the same patterns.
default.name: Daniel Osei

default.quote: I search for a feature name and get every customer who mentioned it. That alone sold us.
default.name: Hannah Wright
